aboutPage.title: About Salem Rizk
aboutPage.heading: From Content Creation to Founding Saey Digital Marketing.
aboutPage.bio1: My journey began in digital content creation — specifically in movie summaries and entertainment content, producing over 600 videos in a short period. It started as a passion for storytelling and creativity, not knowing it would become the foundation for everything that followed.
aboutPage.bio2: While studying, I didn't wait for graduation to gain real experience. I was designing visual identities and building full websites for actual clients — earning hands-on skills that went far beyond any classroom. Every project sharpened both my technical and creative edge simultaneously.
aboutPage.bio3: I took on the role of Administrative & Media Manager at Al-Hilal Alexandrian Club, then progressed to Technical Director. I was fully responsible for the club's digital presence, social media operations, and internal coordination — a real-world school in managing institutions from the inside.
aboutPage.bio4: I led digital marketing for TTC Educational Center in Alexandria, driving measurable growth in enrollment and reach. Then came ESCO Motor Oils — a brand that went from zero digital presence to a recognized name in its industry within months. Both cases became proof that the right strategy delivers results.
aboutPage.bio5: The portfolio expanded to include Vaco clothing store — full digital marketing and creative content from scratch to building a solid presence. Then came Dice Damanhour branch, where I handled all marketing and creative design. On another front, I joined Nojom Al-Mustaqbal Academy as Technical Director — responsible for the visual identity and digital operations. In parallel, I delivered web development projects for clients outside Egypt, adding an international dimension to my experience.
aboutPage.bio6: As the client roster grew and projects diversified, the next step became clear: founding Saey Digital Marketing — a professional, agency-structured operation built on real systems and clear methodology. Saey is not just a name; it's an approach. Every client gets a tailored strategy, every project is managed from brief to result with agency-level standards. Today the active portfolio includes five clients — ESCO, TTC, Dice Damanhour, Vaco, and Dr. Mohamed Abdulaziz Salman's clinic — alongside the Technical Director role at Bara'em Nojom Al-Mustaqbal Academy. One team, one system, real results.
